channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Republic Day scare in Punjab: BJP claims RDX used in blast near railway station
item.description: Targeting the AAP government, BJP leader Sharma said in a statement that the blast, which occurred just days before the Republic Day, exposed negligence in security arrangements and the failure of the state administration.

item.title: ICC replaces Bangladesh with Scotland in Men's T20 World Cup after venue dispute
item.description: Bangladesh had sought to move their group-stage fixtures from India to Sri Lanka, citing security concerns in the wake of fast bowler Mustafizur Rahman being released from the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026. But ICC's decision ends weeks of uncertainty after the BCB repeatedly pressed for a venue change and even suggested swapping groups with Ireland.

item.title: Lawsuit claims Meta can access WhatsApp chats; company calls it 'frivolous'
item.description: A lawsuit filed in a US court has accused Meta and WhatsApp of misleading users by claiming their chats are private, alleging the companies store, analyse, and can access users' communications. The plaintiffs—hailing from countries including India, Brazil, Australia, Mexico, and South Africa—are seeking class-action status and claim WhatsApp's privacy assurances are false

item.title: Voting gives every citizen voice to shape India's future, says PM Modi on National Voters' Day
item.description: National Voters' Day is celebrated annually in India on January 25 to mark the foundation day of the Election Commission of India (ECI) in 1950. This day aims to honour voters, encourage youth participation, strengthen democratic values, and promote universal adult suffrage.

item.title: Steby Ben reacts to trolling over similar outfit as Nupur Sanon: Initially offended, later all laughed it off
item.description: Steby Ben has broken her silence on the trolling around her wearing 'similar' dress to that of bride Nupur Sanon at her wedding reception.

item.title: WHO chief says US reasons for withdrawal 'untrue'
item.description: The formal withdrawal is set to take effect one year after notice, and the issue is on the agenda of the WHO Executive Board. The Trump administration said the exit, carried out through an executive order, was intended to free the US from what it described as the WHO's constraints.

item.title: Javed Akhtar's "creative bankruptcy' remark on Border 2 songs stirs row: Sonu Nigam reacts strongly
item.description: Sonu Nigam has strongly reacted to Javed Akhtar calling the addition of new lyrics in old Border song 'creative bankruptcy'.

item.title: Trump asks his negotiating team to pursue long-term deal in Ukraine: Official
item.description: US President Donald Trump has directed his negotiating team to pursue a long-term deal to prevent a renewed Ukraine war after what officials called productive talks involving Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin. Recent engagements in Davos, Abu Dhabi and Russia led to a US-facilitated trilateral format with Ukraine and Russia, focusing on de-escalation, security guarantees, territorial issues and economic concerns.

item.title: Why stock markets often trade lower ahead of Union Budgets
item.description: Stock markets often trade lower ahead of the Union Budget due to heightened uncertainty and fears of policy surprises, with data from 2010–2022 showing negative average returns for Nifty in the week before the Budget. Volatility typically peaks on Budget day, though markets tend to rebound afterward, posting an average gain of 1.36 per cent in the following week.

item.title: Rain, winds clear Delhi's air, AQI improves to moderate category
item.description: On Sunday morning, the capital's AQI settled at 152, marking the first time in weeks that Delhi recorded a 'moderate' air quality level, according to data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) SAMEER app at 6.05 a.m.
